risks.note: Despite stable revenues, consolidated PAT declined to Rs 1,023.44 lakhs in FY 2025-26, impacted by investments and margin pressures as well as the long gestation period of Scanit's growth.
The Company continues to derive a majority of its revenues from government contracts, which involve longer sales cycles and policy dependencies.
Large-scale projects entail execution complexity and cost management challenges; ABM has previously experienced time and cost overruns, impacting margins.
risks.risk: Execution and cost pressures on large e-Governance projects

risks.note: InstaSafe operates in a highly competitive global cybersecurity market characterised by rapid technological innovation.
Scanit's business involves long gestation cycles, pilot validations, and gradual scaling, impacting near-term earnings visibility.

Rapid advances in AI create a technology-disruption risk that requires ongoing investment in AI application within core business offerings to stay competitive; flagged explicitly as a risk area with an associated mitigation strategy.

Scanit faced a revenue setback in 2025 due to the loss of a couple of major customers, highlighting dependence on a small number of large accounts; the Company has since pursued diversification to reduce single-account dependence.

Scanit continues to navigate macroeconomic pressures affecting farm-level technology adoption, longer sales cycles for large contracts, and the ongoing need to transition its SporeCam technology to full production-grade reliability.
risks.risk: Scanit go-to-market and operational execution risk
